meta.summary: phantompeakqualtools 1.2.2 for strand cross-correlation QC, fragment-length estimation, and SPP peak calling.
meta.description: phantompeakqualtools 1.2.2 for strand cross-correlation QC, fragment-length estimation, and SPP peak calling.

test: Rscript -e 'pkgs <- c("spp","caTools","snow","snowfall","bitops","Rsamtools"); stopifnot(all(vapply(pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly=TRUE))); stopifnot(as.character(packageVersion("spp")) == "1.14"); cat("phantompeakqualtools-runtime-ok\n")' | grep -Fx 'phantompeakqualtools-runtime-ok' >/dev/null && { run_spp.R 2>&1 || true; } | grep -F 'Usage: Rscript run_spp.R <options>' >/dev/null

set -eu; tmp=/tmp/taf-ppqt-tagalign-$$; trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' 0 1 2 3; /opt/phantompeakqualtools/share/testdata/make-smoke-fixtures.sh tagalign "$tmp"; cd "$tmp"; run_spp.R -c=chip.tagAlign -s=-100:5:300 -x=10:60 -out=metrics.tsv -savp=crosscorr.pdf -savd=crosscorr.RData -rf >run.log 2>&1; test "$(gawk -F '\t' 'NR==1 {print NF}' metrics.tsv)" -eq 11; test "$(head -c 4 crosscorr.pdf)" = '%PDF'; test -s crosscorr.RData; grep -F 'Calculating peak characteristics' run.log >/dev/null

set -eu; tmp=/tmp/taf-ppqt-gzip-$$; trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' 0 1 2 3; /opt/phantompeakqualtools/share/testdata/make-smoke-fixtures.sh gzip "$tmp"; cd "$tmp"; run_spp.R -c=chip.tagAlign.gz -s=-100:5:300 -x=10:60 -p=2 -out=parallel.tsv -rf >run.log 2>&1; test "$(gawk -F '\t' 'NR==1 {print NF}' parallel.tsv)" -eq 11; grep -F 'Decompressing ChIP file' run.log >/dev/null; grep -F 'num parallel nodes: 2' run.log >/dev/null

set -eu; tmp=/tmp/taf-ppqt-bamgz-$$; trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' 0 1 2 3; /opt/phantompeakqualtools/share/testdata/make-smoke-fixtures.sh bam "$tmp"; cd "$tmp"; run_spp.R -c=chip.bam.gz -s=-100:5:300 -x=10:60 -out=bam.tsv -rf >run.log 2>&1; test "$(gawk -F '\t' 'NR==1 {print NF}' bam.tsv)" -eq 11; grep -F 'Decompressing ChIP file' run.log >/dev/null; grep -F 'Reading ChIP tagAlign/BAM file chip.bam.gz' run.log >/dev/null

set -eu; tmp=/tmp/taf-ppqt-peaks-$$; trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' 0 1 2 3; /opt/phantompeakqualtools/share/testdata/make-smoke-fixtures.sh peaks "$tmp"; cd "$tmp"; run_spp.R -c=chip.tagAlign -i=control.tagAlign -s=-100:5:300 -x=10:60 -npeak=10 -savn=peaks.narrowPeak -savr=regions.regionPeak -rf >run.log 2>&1; gzip -t peaks.narrowPeak.gz; gzip -t regions.regionPeak.gz; test "$(gzip -cd peaks.narrowPeak.gz | gawk -F '\t' 'NR==1 {print NF}')" -eq 10; test "$(gzip -cd regions.regionPeak.gz | gawk -F '\t' 'NR==1 {print NF}')" -eq 10; grep -F 'Detected ' run.log >/dev/null

set -eu; tmp=/tmp/taf-ppqt-writewig-$$; trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' 0 1 2 3; mkdir -p "$tmp"; Rscript -e 'library(spp); dat <- list(chr1=data.frame(x=c(100,130,200), y=c(1.2,4.0,2.3))); out <- writewig(dat, file.path(commandArgs(TRUE)[1],"track.wig"), "tiny", zip=TRUE); stopifnot(file.exists(out))' "$tmp"; test -s "$tmp/track.wig.zip"; test ! -e "$tmp/track.wig"; zip -T "$tmp/track.wig.zip" >/dev/null

test -s /opt/phantompeakqualtools/share/doc/phantompeakqualtools/README.md && test -s /opt/phantompeakqualtools/share/licenses/phantompeakqualtools/LICENSE && test -s /opt/phantompeakqualtools/share/licenses/spp/GPL-2 && test -s /opt/phantompeakqualtools/share/patches/spp-gcc12.sed && test -s /opt/phantompeakqualtools/share/provenance/debian-packages.tsv && test -s /opt/phantompeakqualtools/share/provenance/r-packages.tsv && echo 'b31263b64aefe97bdc4d7fae138f515a7d7a60cd05031d38dd89a10f9ee10cd1  /opt/phantompeakqualtools/share/source/phantompeakqualtools/phantompeakqualtools-1.2.2.tar.gz' | sha256sum -c -
